goal: At shift handover, retain the version of the summary that the recorder wrote from the handover notes and a different incoming operator acknowledged.

writeSummary.goal: Summarize the handover notes in one paragraph for the incoming operator.

execution.instructions: Read the handover notes and submit a one-paragraph summary. If it is returned, revise that version using the stated reason.

reviewHandover.goal: Compare the summary with the notes and decide whether to accept it.

execution.instructions: An incoming operator distinct from the recorder reviews the notes and submitted summary. Acknowledge an acceptable summary or give the recorder a specific reason for revision.
